Fix slice state colors for Weave-submitted slices

When Weave submits a draft slice bypassing the GUI's submit endpoint,
the draft store wasn't cleaned up, causing get_slice() to serve stale
draft data with "Draft" state instead of the real FABRIC state.

- get_slice(): check registry for UUID before serving a "new draft";
  if found, clean up draft and fetch fresh from FABRIC
- tool_fabric_submit_slice(): clean up draft store and register UUID
  in slice registry after successful submission
- Frontend: update slice list state when loaded data differs from
  list entry (e.g. Draft → StableOK) so badges update immediately

  proxy with header stripping, idle cleanup

Add global cache layer, manual refresh controls, and fix slice loading hangs

Frontend: Move all API data into a global cache in App.tsx. Sites, links,
images, and component models are fetched once (on mount or explicit refresh)
and passed as props to EditorPanel, DetailPanel, and GeoView. Metrics use
a shared cache with manual refresh button and configurable auto-refresh
rate (Manual/5s/10s/30s/1min/5min/10min). Add "↻ Resources" button to
Toolbar for explicit infrastructure refresh.

Backend: Convert heavy FABlib route handlers to async with asyncio.to_thread()
to prevent threadpool exhaustion. Add fast async /metrics 404 endpoint to
stop Prometheus scraper from clogging the threadpool. Fix critical hang in
slice_serializer where Interface.get_ip_addr() fell back to SSH when no
cached IP was available — with expired bastion keys this blocked forever.
Serializer now reads IP/MAC from cached orchestrator data only.

Switch fabrictestbed-extensions to GitHub main branch and add git to
Docker system deps.
